method: direct complete-horizon prediction; no observed future load in any input

data_preparation_metadata.units: whole-building hourly average kW (hourly kWh / 1 h)
data_preparation_metadata.timestamp_policy: source-local naive clock; no timezone conversion or DST/weather join
data_preparation_metadata.missing_policy: No target imputation. Require observed target/lags 1,24,168 and >=80% observed preceding 168h. Forward-fill inputs inside past window only, leading gaps zero; provide missing mask. Zeros retained; no full-series anomaly filter.
data_preparation_metadata.evaluation_protocol: one-hour rolling origin; earlier observed test hours may enter later windows; no parameter refitting on validation/test buildings or periods

source.selection: same 12 IDs as PR7; first requested hours, no outcome selection
source.target_units: average kW over next one-hour meter interval
source.timestamp_basis: source local hourly clock; naive, no UTC or weather join
source.attribution: Clayton Miller, Anjukan Kathirgamanathan, Balaji Picchetti et al., Building Data Genome Project 2 (2020), doi:10.1038/s41597-020-00712-x
source.modifications: 12 raw electricity columns, bounded first hours; no retrospective cleaned-file filters
source.category: overseas whole-building research meters; not Kyrgyz critical circuits

training.optimizer: AdamW .001 decay .001 batch64 SmoothL1 clip1 patience10
